results.title: El Patron De La Plaza
results.overview: In a region where power is measured by territoy and loyalties, the Plaza Boss rules with his hand! His control his control over the most lucrative zone has given him fame and respect, but just as many enemies. While he protects his empire, a silent threat emerges. Hidden enemies waiting for the smallest mistake to undergo a war that could destroy everything.

results.title: It's All Light: Laraaji at Nine Orchard
results.original_title: It's All Light: Laraaji at Nine Orchard
results.overview: A concert film from musician Laraaji featuring visuals by Liquid Light Lab. Filmed 18 October 2023 at Nine Orchard in New York City.

results.title: HomeGoing
results.overview: HomeGoing is a collaborative musical tribute by filmmaker Julie Dash and operatic bass-baritone Davóne Tines, created in remembrance of the Emanuel Nine. Through voice, image and ritual, the film honors the lives taken during Bible study at Mother Emanuel AME Church in Charleston, South Carolina, in 2015. Tines’ performance becomes an offering of grief and resilience, while Dash’s restrained visual language creates a space for reflection, remembrance and dignity.

results.title: Clout
results.overview: Oskar's desperate pursuit of online fame takes a tragic turn when his claims of discovering a dead body are dismissed by his friends at boarding school, leading him down a dark path in an attempt to prove himself.

results.title: Amagi Goe
results.overview: Amagi Goe, based on Seicho Matsumoto's novel, has created numerous stars through its visualizations. Erika Ikuta will take on the difficult role of the main character in this adaptation.

results.title: FIGHTER
results.overview: A girl who’s tired of life finds refuge and passion within the gaming world. However, her will to fight only extends to her VR boxing matches, rather than the outside world.

results.title: Nkondi
results.overview: Nkondi is a short animation set in the Congo, and merges traditional oral incantation and storytelling with the mysticism of animism to spark a narrative of defiance

results.title: RICK or le making of de nouvelle vague
results.original_title: RICK or le making of de nouvelle vague
results.overview: The making of Nouvelle Vague and the opportunity to make a portrait of Richard Linklater.

results.title: Pierre Boulez - Der Weg ins Unbekannte
results.original_title: Pierre Boulez - Der Weg ins Unbekannte

results.title: Relentless Memory
results.overview: Committed to unearthing her ancestors' silenced history, Margarita embarks on a profound journey, guided by the diary of Katrulaf, an indigenous Mapuche prisoner of war. She retraces the Mapuches’ deportation route, and in unearthing these pasts, gives voice to a displaced people and the genocide inflicted upon them during the military invasions that founded Argentina and Chile.

results.title: Skewers
results.overview: A chef named Ģirts from the countryside is encouraged to move to Rīga and open a new restaurant.

results.title: Tenderness
results.overview: Lee, a young man in Chengdu China, writes a letter to Sam, his former English teacher and lover from the US, reminiscing about their brief but profound relationship. He recalls their time together through past and present moments—exploring the city, learning from each other, and falling in love. But Sam had to return to the U.S., leaving Lee with cherished yet painful memories. "Tenderness" is a poetic tale of love, loss, and the lingering warmth of a connection that remains unforgettable.

results.title: The Ride
results.overview: A '76 Plymouth reflects on its journey, witnessing decades of human life, capturing moments of freedom, temptation, and redemption as it changes hands from one owner to the next. A failed actress, a desperate father, two outlaws on the run – and The Ride that remembers all of them.

results.title: Udaipur Files: Kanhaiya Lal Tailor Murder
results.original_title: Udaipur Files: Kanhaiya Lal Tailor Murder
results.overview: In June 2022, Kanhaiya Lal Sahu, a tailor in Udaipur, India, was brutally murdered. The events surrounding the murder are explored, delving into the conspiracy and the deeper issues of religious extremism, digital radicalization, and intelligence failures that led to the tragic event.

results.title: Segundo Contacto
results.overview: “In 1980, a mysterious UFO sighting was recorded in the Bardenas Reales. Forty years later, Álvaro is convinced that the phenomenon will happen again and drags his best friend Marcos along to document it. The trip takes an unexpected turn when Lucía, Marcos’s ex-girlfriend, crosses their path.”

results.title: Honey
results.overview: Honey (13) is shy and lies about herself and her chaotic family, and generally finds it difficult to show who she is in her new class. She loves to play music – and is really good – just no one knows.  Honey just wants a place in Liam's band Full Smash, so when she finds out that her dead, music-loving grandfather Marcel might not be dead at all, she decides to find him. Maybe he's just what she needs so she can finally learn to stand up for herself.

results.title: CBD Nation
results.overview: CBD Nation examines the real research and evidence surrounding one of the safest, most therapeutically active medicines known to humanity. The documentary features the world's leading experts in the field of cannabis scientific research, and follows the emotional stories of several patients who bravely took control of their own medical journeys - often in the face of powerful resistance - to significantly improve their quality of life.

results.title: Bat Out of Hell: The Musical
results.original_title: Bat Out of Hell: The Musical
results.overview: Step into the dystopian city of Obsidian, where a rebellious gang called The Lost can never grow old. At the heart of this rock opera is a fiery romance between their leader, Strat, and Raven, the sheltered daughter of the city’s tyrannical ruler, Falco—a love story as defiant as the music itself.

results.title: Minister Chucky
results.overview: As the specter of rising fascism looms, a queer couple celebrates their love with an unconventional Vegas wedding—officiated by Chucky, the killer doll—before making their escape to Canada.

results.title: Whispers of Exiles
results.overview: A healer woman works as a narrator in the theater, telling a story of other women who have the same ability as her. In the story, powerful women always end up in exile. Turns out, history never changes. When her work friends find out about her power, she also ends up the same way.
